messages:
Elaine: Noticed a bug in the rerank API docs. The request example in docs/reference/rerank.md shows a top-level array of docs and a single \"query\" field. Our runtime expects {\"queries\": [...], \"documents\": [...] } for batch rerank. Users are sending the old shape and getting 422s.

Marco: Oof. Which PR/file?

Elaine: docs/reference/rerank.md in PR #5240. Current example: 
```json
POST /v1/rerank
[
  {\"id\":1,\"text\":\"doc a\"},
  {\"id\":2,\"text\":\"doc b\"}
]
```
It should be:
```json
POST /v1/rerank
{
  \"queries\": [\"how to start\"],
  \"documents\": [{\"id\":1,\"text\":\"doc a\"},{\"id\":2,\"text\":\"doc b\"}]
}
```

Priya: Also the JS SDK snippet in the same page sometimes shows client.rerank.run(\"single query\", docs) and other times client.rerank.run({ queries: [\"q\"] , documents: [...] }). We should standardize: show object form for batch and a separate single-query example using { queries: [\"q\"] }.

Ken: docs-bot posted a CI failure this morning for examples-lint.

docs-bot: PR #5240  examples-lint  failed: example_request_shape mismatch on docs/reference/rerank.md. CI logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/5240/logs

Marco: Plan: Elaine can update the docs page example and the curl/JS blocks to use the canonical object shape. Priya can patch the OpenAPI examples so generated SDK snippets consistently show input objects. Ken, can you add a small unit test to examples-lint to reject top-level arrays for POST /v1/rerank?

Elaine: I'll open a tiny PR to replace the example and add a short migration note: \"Note: Rerank API accepts { \"queries\": [...], \"documents\": [...] } for batch requests. Single-query usage should still be wrapped as { \"queries\": [\"...\"] } for consistency.\"

Priya: I'll update specs/openapi/rerank.yaml primary example to the object form and add an explicit examples.single and examples.batch blocks. Then I'll regen the language snippets.

Ken: Adding the examples-lint rule now; will be a small regex-based check that parses JSON blocks for POST /v1/rerank and fails on top-level arrays. I'll include it in the same PR where possible.

docs-bot: PR #5245 opened by Elaine  docs quickfix for rerank examples. CI pending.

Elaine: Local preview shows the corrected examples render fine. Curl + staging returns 200 when I send {\"queries\": [\"q\"], \"documents\": [...] }.

Priya: OpenAPI PR #5248 up with canonical examples and regenerated snippets.

Ken: Lint test added in PR #5250. Running CI now.

docs-bot: PR #5245 merged  CI green. PR #5248 and #5250 pending review.

Marco: Thanks everyone. Once 5248 and 5250 land we'll update CHANGELOG: \"docs(rerank): standardize request shape examples; add examples-lint check\" and close the issue.

Elaine: Marking tracker resolved after the remaining PRs merge. :white_check_mark:
